messages:
nina: Hey @people-ops — lost my physical ID card while traveling for work. I need to pick up a refill for my chronic medication today in a few hours. The pharmacy says they need member ID and plan name to process. Can I use the digital card or get a temporary proof?

benefits-bot: Tip: digital ID cards are available at https://benefits.redwood.com > ID Cards. If dependent or recent change, carrier sync may delay. Temporary proof of coverage letter is under Documents > Temporary Member Letter. Pharmacies commonly accept a digital card + photo ID.

Rohit: Hi Nina  sorry about the hassle. Quick checklist for pharmacy pickup: 1) show digital ID (screenshot or PDF) 2) pharmacy phone can call carrier for real-time eligibility (they can verify with member ID + DOB) 3) you can forward temporary coverage letter to the pharmacy email if they need written proof.

nina: I can access the portal but the digital card PDF shows my dependent but not my updated plan code (I switched tiers last month). The portal header shows "Plan: Redwood Plus PPO (pending)". Will that block the pharmacy?

pharmacy-support: Pharmacies typically use the insurer's eligibility lookup in real time. If the portal says "pending" it may not have yet synced to the carrier. Important: provide the prescription BIN/PTR info to the pharmacy and ask them to run eligibility with member name + DOB. If they hit a deny, ask them to note the deny code and hold the RX while we confirm with the carrier.

Rohit: Action: Nina, can you DM me your member ID (or last 4) and DOB? I can call the carrier's provider support line and request an eligibility verification and ask for an override/CAN (call authorization number) if needed. Also I can generate a temporary coverage letter from our portal and email it to the pharmacy.

nina: DM sent: Member ID 771122334, DOB 1990-07-15. Pharmacy: Central Pharmacy Downtown, phone 555-2301, email centralpharm@example.com. Prescription name: metformin 500mg, 90-day refill. Thanks Rohit.

Rohit: Got it. Calling carrier now. (Call log snippet): "Agent confirmed member active on Redwood Plus PPO effective 2026-03-01. Eligibility verified for pharmacy claim. Carrier provided verification ref VER-8421. Please accept digital ID and process claim; no pre-auth required." I'll email the pharmacy the temp letter + VER-8421.

pharmacy-support: Received the email from Rohit and carrier ref. Pharmacy confirmed they processed the refill and will hold for pickup until 18:00 today. They asked Nina to bring photo ID and a screenshot of the digital card.

nina: Wonderful  thank you both! Two quick follow-ups: 1) can you issue a replacement physical card mailed to my hotel address? 2) is there a secure way to get a copy of the phone call transcript or ref?

Rohit: I'll request a physical card reissue to your home address; for urgent travel we can instead mail to your hotel but it takes extra verification. I submitted reissue req REISSUE-20260322-5 to carrier. For call ref, carrier provided VER-8421 and said they log the call; we don't get full transcript but the ref number is sufficient if any dispute arises. If you want hotel mailing, DM me the hotel address and we'll confirm with carrier.

nina: I'll DM the hotel address. Thanks again  really saved my afternoon. :pray:
